_comment: Pterodactyl egg for the ATV 2 online server list and relay (atv2-server). Import it under Admin > Nests.
name: ATV 2 Server List
author: atv2@example.com
description: The ATV Quad Power Racing 2 rewrite's online server list: hosts list their races (name, password, track, laps, players) and players join them through it, with the race's packets relayed so nobody opens a port. One UDP port: the server's allocation. Upload the atv2-server binary to the server's files before starting it.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
  curl -fsSL -o atv2-server "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" && chmod +x atv2-server
fi
echo 'If atv2-server is not in the files yet, upload it there (File Manager), then start the server.'

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Optional: a direct link to the atv2-server Linux binary, fetched when the server is installed or reinstalled. Leave empty to upload the file yourself.
